description: List your consulting partner's simulation workspaces: one per client you are onboarding, each its own Spark account where the client's data comes in and nothing is ever sent to QuickBooks. Shows each workspace's client, owner, when it is deleted, whether you can open it, and which one this credential is connected to. The partner is the one you are on the team of; it is never a parameter. Acts as a person, so it needs Spark's OAuth connector or Sparki (a static org token is refused). The run, read and snapshot tools work on the workspace this credential is connected to; to work in another, connect to it.
name: list_simulation_workspaces
title: List Simulation Workspaces
